title: Itinerary and rooms
description: The legs of the journey, groups, packing, transport and rooms — every time is shown both in the local zone and in Romanian time.
closedNotice: This occasion is closed: you can read everything, but nothing can be changed.

hub.emptyTitle: The itinerary is empty for now
hub.emptyBody: Add the flight, the train or the stay — or paste the booking confirmation and we will read it.
hub.emptyBodyMember: When the organisers add the legs of the trip, you will see them here.
hub.doneBody: Every leg of the itinerary is behind you.

figures.packingNote: of the lists you can see

leg.title: What it is
leg.startsHint: Type the time on the ticket — the local time at the departure point.
leg.zoneHint: Search for the city, for example Europe/Lisbon.
leg.endsHint: The local time at the arrival point, as printed on the ticket.
leg.endTzHint: Leave empty if it is the same as at departure.
leg.referenceHint: As printed on the confirmation. It helps spot duplicates when importing.
leg.subgroupHint: A group's leg is seen only by that group's people and the organisers.
leg.clockNote: The clock at arrival reads earlier than the one at departure. That is right: the zones differ, and the duration above is the real one.

itinerary.title: Itinerary
itinerary.description: Every time appears in the zone of the place and, beside it, in Romanian time.
itinerary.emptyBody: Start with the outbound journey. You can also paste the confirmation email — we show what we understood before adding anything.
itinerary.deleteBody: “{title}” disappears from the itinerary for everyone.

import.title: Import a booking
import.description: Paste the confirmation or pick the .ics file you received. We read only what is certain — dates, times, flight numbers, the booking code — and invent nothing. Nothing is added until you confirm.
import.text: The confirmation text or the content of the .ics file
import.textHint: You can paste the whole email; what is not about the trip is ignored.
import.fileHint: The file is read on your device and placed in the field above.
import.fileLoaded: “{name}” was read. Check the text and press the button below.
import.fileTooBig: The file is too large. Pick one under 300 KB.
import.zone: Time zone for times that carry none
import.zoneHint: Pasted confirmations do not state a zone. Their times are read in this zone and marked “to check”.
import.previewBody: This is the list of changes. The itinerary stays untouched until you press “Apply the changes”.
import.previewFoot: Legs marked “to complete” have fields we could not read reliably; fill them in from the itinerary after applying.
import.nothingFound: We found no date with a time we could rely on in this text. Check that you pasted the whole confirmation, or add the leg by hand.

groups.title: Groups and activities
groups.description: Split people into smaller groups and offer activities that anyone who wants can join.
groups.heading: Groups
groups.name: Group name
groups.leadHint: They can add legs and lists for their group.
groups.leadEmailHint: Only if they are not on the team yet.
groups.emptyBody: Groups help when some people have a different plan: a day trip, another flight, another place to stay.
groups.emptyTitleMember: You are not in any group
groups.emptyBodyMember: The groups you belong to show up here, with their people and plans.
groups.nobody: Nobody is in the group yet.
groups.pickLabel: Tick the people in the group
groups.deleteBody: “{name}” disappears. Its legs and activities stay, but become visible to everyone.

activities.heading: Optional activities
activities.name: What you propose
activities.costHint: Leave empty if you do not know it yet — it shows as unknown, not as zero.
activities.capacityHint: Leave empty if there is no limit.
activities.subgroupHint: A group's activity is seen only by that group.
activities.emptyBody: Propose something people can join: a hike, a museum, a dinner.
activities.emptyBodyMember: When an activity appears, you can join it from here.
activities.noLimit: No limit on places · signed up: {taken}

packing.title: Packing
packing.description: Each list is a task with ticks: you will find it under Tasks too, with the same ticks.
packing.name: List name
packing.scopeHint: Only you see a personal list.
packing.subgroupHint: Only matters when the list is for a group.
packing.startersBody: Pick the kind of trip and get a ready-made personal list you can change as you like.
packing.emptyBody: Pick a kind of trip below or make your own list.
packing.noItems: The list is empty. Add the first item below.
packing.deleteBody: “{name}” disappears with all its ticks, from Tasks too.

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: Cars, minibuses, transfers: who rides in what. A seat is taken once, even if two people tap at the same moment.
transport.label: Vehicle
transport.seatsHint: Leave empty if you do not know — it shows as unknown.
transport.emptyBody: Add the cars or transfers and give people their seats.
transport.emptyBodyMember: When vehicles appear, you can take your seat from here.
transport.pickIntro: The vehicle has {total} seats. A household takes one seat per person.
transport.deleteBody: “{name}” disappears together with its reserved seats.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Pick the room, tick the people, press “Place here”. A bed cannot be given twice.
rooms.name: Room name
rooms.priceHint: Leave empty if you do not know it — it shows as unknown.
rooms.emptyBody: Add the rooms with their number of beds, then place people in them.
rooms.emptyBodyMember: When the organisers allocate rooms, yours shows up here.
rooms.assignIntro: Beds free now: {left}. Ticking someone placed in another room moves them here.
rooms.deleteBody: “{name}” disappears and the people placed in it are left without a bed.
rooms.memberNote: You see how full the rooms are and who shares yours. The organisers do the allocation.

settlement.title: Settlement
settlement.description: Who paid, who owes and who gives whom — separately for each currency, from the same shared-costs ledger.
settlement.descriptionOwn: Your part of the shared costs, for each currency.
settlement.ownNotice: You see your own line only. The rest of the settlement is for people with access to money.
settlement.separateNotice: There are {count} currencies and each is settled on its own. We do not convert: a euro stays a euro.
settlement.currencyOtherHint: The three-letter code, for example CHF. If you type it, it takes precedence.
settlement.forHint: The amount is split evenly between those ticked.
settlement.emptyBody: Add the first cost and choose the currency it was paid in.
settlement.emptyBodyOwn: When shared costs you take part in appear, you will see here what you owe or are owed.
settlement.noPeopleBody: Add at least two participants in the shared-costs ledger, then come back here.
settlement.notParticipantTitle: You are not part of the shared costs
settlement.notParticipantBody: If you should be, ask the organiser to add you.
settlement.settled: Nobody owes anything in this currency.
settlement.noteOnly: a note only: amounts are not converted.
settlement.noteIntro: Write the rate you exchanged at so everyone has it to hand. It stays a note: it changes no amount and never merges currencies.
settlement.noteExample: 1 EUR ≈ 4.97 RON at the exchange office

exports.itineraryDescription: Every leg you can see, with local and Romanian time.
exports.roomingDescription: Who stays in which room and who has no bed yet.

errors.timeZone: We do not know this time zone. Pick one from the list, for example Europe/Lisbon.
errors.dateTime: Enter the full date and time.
errors.endBeforeStart: The arrival cannot be before the departure. Check the time zones too.
errors.unknownPerson: The chosen person is no longer part of this occasion. Reload the page.
errors.activityFull: There are not enough places left for this activity. Places left: {left}.
errors.vehicleFull: There are not enough seats left in the vehicle. Seats free: {left}.
errors.roomFull: The room does not have enough free beds: you ticked {need}, {left} are left. Nobody was moved.
errors.placedElsewhere: Someone has just placed one of these people in another room. Reload the page and try again.
errors.bedsBelowOccupants: The room already has {occupants} people placed. Remove someone before lowering the number of beds.
errors.currency: Enter the three-letter currency code, for example CHF.
